headline: Goals and injury concerns before the EPL resumes
summary: Viktor Gyokeres scored in every Sweden game during the break, giving Arsenal encouragement before they host Leeds on 10 October. The Premier League's roundup also flags fitness concerns before Liverpool face Manchester City: Haaland asked to come off for Norway, while Liverpool's Isak, Gakpo and Jacquet have injury problems. Clubs still need to confirm who will be available.
